user.title: Set up Climate Hub
user.description:
Found in your home:

- {rooms} areas with a climate sensor or thermostat
- {outdoor} areas with a temperature sensor that could be outside
- {contacts} window and door contacts
- {weather} weather services

data_description.weather: Provides the forecast for the daily strategy and the outside values when all outdoor sensors fail.
data_description.area_sync: Enters the climate values of the rooms and outdoor sides as the temperature and humidity sensor of their areas. Area cards then show the reliable value.

rooms.title: Which areas are rooms?
rooms.description: For each room, the sensors are combined into one value. Areas with a temperature sensor or a thermostat are shown. Outdoor areas are not checked.

data_description.rooms: The preview shows which sensors are used per room. You change the order later per room.

plan.title: House plan
plan.description:
Assign each side of the house its outdoor area and the rooms whose windows face that way. Sides without an outdoor area, such as a wall facing the neighbour, stay empty.

Simply leave out interior rooms without windows.

reconfigure.title: House plan
reconfigure.description:
Assign each side of the house its outdoor area and the rooms whose windows face that way. Sides without an outdoor area, such as a wall facing the neighbour, stay empty.

Simply leave out interior rooms without windows.

plan_preview.title: Preview
plan_preview.description:
These sources are suggested for new or changed outdoor sides. You change their order later per outdoor side.
